text:
sophie: FYI billing escalation from GreenOrbit — they got auto-dunned and service suspended after we couldn't link their PO to the invoice. Customer says PO was submitted but their finance team can't see the invoice in their AP system. Can someone take a look?

liam: can you paste the invoice id and the dunning reason? also whether this was a card or PO flow.

sophie: invoice INV-2026-0893, dunning state: FINAL_NOTICE -> SUSPENDED. From the webhook logs I see a gateway reject at the PO-apply step. Snippet from our payment logs:```json
{"invoice_id":"INV-2026-0893","method":"purchase_order","error":"PO_VALIDATION_FAILED","details":"missing_required_field: billing.vat_id"}```

rebecca: hmm — PO_VALIDATION_FAILED because VAT id missing. GreenOrbit is EU-based and our policy requires VAT registration for PO processing if tax_exempt=false. Did support collect the VAT ID when onboarding?

sophie: customer says they included VAT on their PO PDF, but our ingestion showed an empty `billing.vat_id`. Repro steps I used: 1) upload PO PDF in support console -> 2) system OCR -> 3) create PO record -> 4) attempt invoice payment via PO -> validation fails. I can forward the original PO PDF if needed.

jordan: can we check the PO record in the internal DB? maybe OCR failed or mapping key changed after the form update. If it's a data issue we can manually attach the VAT and re-run the PO apply flow to unblock.

liam: @payments-bot can you show the invoice timeline + last gateway event for INV-2026-0893?

payments-bot: Automated update: Invoice INV-2026-0893: created 2026-03-01, dunning started 2026-03-15. Last payment attempt (PO apply) 2026-03-22 14:12:09 UTC -> status PO_VALIDATION_FAILED (code 422). Linked customer: acct_GOrbit_778. Retry window exhausted -> transition to SUSPENDED.

rebecca: Sophie, pls attach the PO PDF and the AP contact email. I'll pull the DB row and manually update `billing.vat_id` if the VAT number is present in the PDF. If the VAT number is not present on the PO we'll need customer to re-issue PO with VAT or provide a VAT registration record.

sophie: attaching PO now (uploaded to thread). VAT number is on page 1 near top: GB999888777. It's definitely present in the PDF. Looks like our OCR template missed the top header after the March 2026 template change.

jordan: OK — remediation plan: re-run ingestion with adjusted OCR template + manual patch. For immediate restore we can set invoice back to ACTIVE and schedule a one-time collection job after we confirm PO link. We need finance approval to waive the final dunning lock so service can be unsuspended. @liam / @rebecca can we do a manual override for this customer?

liam: I'm OK to approve a one-off restore given this is clearly an ingestion bug and customer provided proof. Please add an internal note and mark as "waive-final-dunning". Also we need a short postmortem and fix: add a unit test for the new PO template and a retry on missing `billing.vat_id` that prompts manual review instead of auto-suspending.

rebecca: done. I patched the PO row in the DB, re-ran the PO-apply flow: new result -> `SUCCESS`. payments-bot should pick up the change and clear dunning. I unsuspended the customer's service at 14:15 UTC.

payments-bot: Automated update: Invoice INV-2026-0893: PO applied successfully at 2026-03-22 14:16:08 UTC, payment status: AUTHORIZED via purchase_order (txn_po_98765). Dunning cleared, account acct_GOrbit_778 set to ACTIVE.

sophie: Customer confirmed they have access again and AP team saw the invoice link in their system. Leaving a support note and sending them the corrected invoice. Thanks everyone. Do we want a small postmortem in eng-billing about the OCR regression? :eyes:

liam: yes — please put a 1-paragraph incident note in eng-billing and tag eng-ml. I'll add the unit test ticket. :thumbsup:

sophie: marking resolved. Closing thread.
